name: Novig API API
description: Read-only Novig exchange data with names resolved, intraday line history, fair no-vig prices and line-move alerts, over REST, MCP and a live stream. No Novig account, no ID check, no request signing. Credits: 1 per 100 rows requested, times the endpoint weight; errors and 304 cost nothing. Stream: wss://stream.novigapi.com/v1/stream, 2 credits per 285 seconds connected. Independent. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Novig.
